title: Ashbury Rewards Console Reference: Stay Credit Reversal after a Folio Correction
content:
When a folio correction removes eligible spend from a stay that was already credited, the points earned on the removed spend are taken back from the Ashbury Rewards account as one stay credit reversal transaction. The reversal names the base points earning transaction it reduces and records the eligible spend removed.

## Conditions of the result

- A reversal is posted only when the stay has an earning transaction.
- Corrections that do not touch eligible spend, such as resort fee, tax, parking or late check-out adjustments, reverse nothing.
- A reversal is posted even when it leaves the points balance below zero; a negative balance blocks redemptions and transfers until it is restored by later earning.

## Capability

`reverse_corrected_stay_points_b6469913` takes back from an Ashbury Rewards account the points earned on stay spend that a folio correction removed. One call records one stay credit reversal transaction of source `stay_credit_reversal` that names the stay, the base points transaction it reduces and the eligible spend removed, dated today, and takes the points off the points balance of the membership, even below zero. The member sees the reversal in their account activity and the lower balance straight away.

## Invocation

An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, giving the name `reverse_corrected_stay_points_b6469913`, and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `loyalty_member_id` | Reference number of the Ashbury Rewards membership debited, as returned by the membership lookup for the verified member | Identifier |
| `reservation_id` | Reference number of the stay whose folio was corrected, as returned by the reservation or folio lookup | Identifier |
| `related_transaction_id` | Reference number of the stay's base points earning transaction that the reversal reduces, as returned by the account activity lookup | Identifier |
| `eligible_spend_usd` | Eligible spend removed by the folio correction, in USD | Plain number with 2 decimal places, such as 1234.50, no currency sign; stored rounded half to even to 2 decimal places |
| `points` | Points taken back | Whole number of points, always positive; integer, no decimals, no thousands separators |

The tool takes no source parameter: it always records the source `stay_credit_reversal`.

## Return

A dictionary string with `transaction_id` (reference number of the reversal transaction created), `loyalty_member_id` (membership debited), `reservation_id` (stay named), `related_transaction_id` (earning transaction reduced), `eligible_spend_usd` (USD removed, 2 decimal places), `points` (integer points taken back), `posted_date` (posting date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `points_balance` (points balance once the points are taken off). A returned `transaction_id` means the reversal is posted.
